# CryptoPrism

> CryptoPrism is an AI-native financial intelligence platform that transforms fragmented on-chain, derivatives, market and sentiment data into explainable investment intelligence — via a conversational analyst (Saarthi), a proprietary DMV conviction score, and an AI screener. Currently in private beta.

## Key facts
- Type: AI-native financial intelligence platform (web app)
- Audience: crypto traders, analysts and institutions
- Status: Private beta, onboarding select teams
- Differentiator: explainable, source-cited intelligence (not black-box)
- Core IP: DMV score (Direction + Magnitude + Volatility), validated out-of-sample at AUC 0.896, patent planned
- Platform: SaaS, invite-gated
- Deployed: cryptoprism.io (AWS S3 + CloudFront)

## The value proposition

The market can be unpredictable. CryptoPrism replaces bias with explainable intelligence — turning optimal decisions into the obvious outcome. Every score, signal and answer ships with its source, so you know not just what, but why.

## Product pillars

### 01 / Saarthi — AI that cites its work
A conversational analyst trained on on-chain metrics, derivatives flows and historical regimes. Every claim ships with a source. Data-backed and source-cited — no black-box answers.

### 02 / DMV Score — one score, three dimensions fused
Direction, Magnitude and Volatility are collapsed into a single conviction score, validated out-of-sample at AUC 0.896 (patent planned).

- Direction: whale flows, exchange reserves, active addresses
- Magnitude: funding rate, OI delta, volume regime
- Volatility: realized vol, social velocity, RSI structure

### 03 / Closed loop — Discover → Trade → Journal → Learn
Every entry auto-captures the on-chain context that informed it. Saarthi reviews your journal to surface the patterns you actually traded — and the ones that worked.

## Platform features

### Unified Dashboard
- Daily AI Briefing — markets summarized before your first coffee.
- Live Market Intelligence — news, macro, on-chain and sentiment updated continuously.
- Explainable Research — every signal backed by transparent reasoning.

### AI Screener
- Natural Language — describe what you're looking for in plain English.
- AI-Powered Screening — AI understands context and applies hundreds of signals instantly.
- Actionable Results — opportunities ranked by Prism Score and key alpha drivers.

### Public Screens
- AI-crafted screens from millions of data points.
- Browse by category (Chart Patterns, Momentum, Multi-Factor, On-Chain, Value) or sentiment.
- Turn any screen into a conversation and go deeper with AI.

### Analytics
- Overview, On-Chain, Market, Derivatives, Flows.

## Enterprise / Institutional

The CryptoPrism Intelligence Layer is institutional-grade infrastructure powering institutional decisions — one intelligence layer, infinite possibilities.
